review_text: Good food, good pricing, super great coffee, better than the average coffee shops in downtown, freshly ground coffee each time. They will offer you fans to keep off the mosquitoes, and the living room vibe at the second floor is a good place for friends and meetings. There needs to be improved on dealing with insects during the night cause the lights attracts them, so maybe placing insect lamps surrounding the cafe will prevent them getting attracted by the lights inside. Overall it was good experience.
